apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Skipping now cuts off whatever is being said. Spoken lines stop where the next exercise (or your skip) lands.

Voice is now recorded into the session's audio file, so instructions can't drop out or talk over cues. The next likely session is prepared ahead on the Today screen, so Start plays right away. Skips land on the next exercise's spoken intro.

Audio fixes from your diagnostics: the native player now actually switches on (it was being skipped at launch), restarts no longer pile up when you skip, faster start, and a crash when ending a session mid-start is gone. Diagnostics now log timings and whether the native audio module answers.
